description: Prepare authorizing or revoking MidnightBundlesV2 on Midnight for the user. The other Midnight prepare tools add the authorization when they need it, so call this only to revoke it or to authorize ahead of time. Returns one unsigned transaction.

isAuthorized.description: true authorizes MidnightBundlesV2 on Midnight; false revokes it
